notes.title: Super GunWorld 2 available now!
notes.notes:
Super GunWorld 2 is out now as a free update to GunWorld 2. It adds additional content to Level Rush mode, brand new Totem stages to the Story Mode, redone art and spritework, and a host of balance updates like Checkpoints and tweaked level design to improve the user experience and make the game more accessible.

There's never been a better time to check out the sequel nobody asked for, to the game that nobody liked!

notes.title: GunWorld 2 Keyboard Control Updates
notes.notes:
Hey all, thanks for supporting m07games and GunWorld 2!

I just wanted to mention that I've been alerted to some issues that have been affecting users who play the game with a keyboard as opposed to a controller.

I've released about 3 updates so far to fix the control interface to make keyboard's work as flawlessly as controllers, and I have a 4th coming out tonight. I apologize for the inconvenience, but after tonight's update keyboards should work perfect! 

I plan on adding a keyboard controls sheet to the pause menu in a future update, and updating all text during the tutorial to give you both the controller and keyboard inputs for each function.
